method_note: Generated raw situations first and rejected care/logistics/usefulness as the central engine.

candidates.title: The Chairs Disagreed
candidates.raw_situation: They keep saying they are just talking, just friends, just meeting casually, but every time they sit somewhere, the chairs end up closer than the story they are telling themselves.
candidates.possible_hook: we were just friends. the chairs disagreed.
candidates.relatable_trigger: People who pretended a connection was casual while their body language quietly confessed first.
candidates.visual_evidence: Cafe or home-table sequence: two chairs start politely apart, then angle inward, then one bag/dupatta/foot crosses the invisible border, while both faces pretend nothing happened.
candidates.why_not_generic: The confession lives in furniture movement, not in a love quote.
candidates.risk_notes: Must avoid generic cafe-date prettiness; the chair positions must do the storytelling.

candidates.title: The Sock Fight Was Not About The Sock
candidates.raw_situation: Aachu starts a tiny dramatic fight about a sock on the floor, but the real point is that she wants Zuv to follow her into the room and make the mood unserious again.
candidates.possible_hook: some fights are just 'come here' written badly.
candidates.relatable_trigger: Couples who know the fight is not the real subject, but still have to perform it properly.
candidates.visual_evidence: Bedroom doorway, one abandoned sock, Aachu pointing at it like evidence, Zuv half-guilty half-amused, final beat where she is still scolding but leaning toward him.
candidates.why_not_generic: It turns a fake domestic prosecution into affection without making one partner a fool.
candidates.risk_notes: Can become too quote-like if the sock is not treated as absurdly serious evidence.

candidates.title: The Full Name Weather Warning
candidates.raw_situation: In public, nothing looks wrong. But the second Aachu calls him 'Zuv' instead of whatever soft name she normally uses, he knows there is a whole post-event debrief waiting.
candidates.possible_hook: when she uses your full name, check the weather inside the car.
candidates.relatable_trigger: Couples with private danger-signals: full names, one-word replies, a specific smile that means the real conversation is later.
candidates.visual_evidence: Restaurant or car-ride after: public smile in the background, then inside the car she looks out the window while he realizes the full-name alarm has gone off.
candidates.why_not_generic: It is about one private signal, not a generic 'women are angry' joke.
candidates.risk_notes: Needs tenderness and specificity or it becomes old husband-wife danger humor.

risk_notes: The freshest path is new-love denial or affection disguised as petty performance, not another proof-of-care idea.
